d.ko: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.
d.en: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.
d.zh: 机场管制 Airport Control 是新一代 3D 空中交通管制模拟游戏。你将在世界各地的机场中担任不同席位的 ATC，引导航班滑行，调配跑道起降，无论白天黑夜，无论大风雨雪，在安全的前提下，确保航班按时进出港。请牢记：在岗一分钟，安全60秒！
